Q: Write multi-columns to CSV with for loop A:

To use the csv module, just open the file for writing once, wrap it in the csv.writer, then generate the data and write it a row at a time. Working example:

import csv

with open('output.csv', mode='w', newline='') as file:  # open the file once
    writer = csv.writer(file)  # wrap it in a writer once
    for c1, c2, c3 in ((1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6)):  # generate the data
        writer.writerow([c1, c2, c3])  # write one row with a list of the data

In your case (non-working, but rearranged):

import csv

                uv_coords = loop[uv_lay].uv
                vert_ind = vert.index
                u = uv_coords[0]
                v = uv_coords[1]
                data = [vert_ind, u, v]  # one dimensional list
                writer.writerow(data)    # writerow (not writerows if one row)

Q: Can a web assembly be packaged as a Windows DLL? A:

No one writes in WebAssembly. WebAssembly is an "intermediate language" that is created by compiling something written in a higher-level language, like C or C++ or Python. So, what you need to do is find the source code that was used to create the WebAssembly, and compile it in a native compiler.

Q: SQL Server 2008 R2 installation error A:

The one thing that i know is that even when you install any type of program it creates registry entries. Sometimes keys are kept there or in a log file. Uninstalling the program will do you no good if you were running a trial version of SQL-Server. you will have to delete the directories out of ProgramFiles on your local hdd and also out of the registry. This has been a workaround for me for all trial version programs that i have ever installed. when deleting from the registry be careful that you don't delete something that you are not suppose too. Otherwise a format should be in order. Running something as administrator as far as I know does not solve this problem. Unless proof can be provided.

Also on a side note. before uninstalling SQL-Server you must stop the instances for it to delete all components related to SQL
